deviations.description: Rule A is not implemented: the network has no cov-vs-cap feature (all cap weights are tiny), so requests whose coverage goal exceeds the hot-spot cap are sent to automated planning whenever no other escalation rule (mandible, cord, missing structure) applies.
deviations.condition: (cov > cap) and (missing == 0) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
